hooks.command:
python -c "
import json, sys, subprocess, os, tempfile
lock = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), '.claude_gcf_lock')
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')
if 'git commit' in cmd and '--amend' in cmd and not os.path.exists(lock):
    try:
        open(lock, 'w').close()
        subprocess.run(['git', 'cl', 'format'], capture_output=True)
        status = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--name-only'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if status.stdout.strip():
            subprocess.run(['git', 'add', '-A'])
            subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '--amend', '--no-edit'])
            print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PostToolUse', 'additionalContext': 'Hook: git cl format applied and amended into commit.'}}))
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(lock): os.remove(lock)
"
